features: Active Notification Engine to alert you whenever your saved fics get new chapter updates.
Books Tracking Module to log pages read, track annual book goals, and rate physical/e-books alongside your AO3 fics.
Added a Data Export tool to seamlessly download and back up all your reading history and extension data.
AO3 Marker Wrapped (End of Year Summary) with a Bento Grid layout to visualize your reading habits.
Multi-Year Storage System with automatic archiving and cloud sync to preserve historical data.
Added time and date to chapter reviews.
Added a helpful error prompt during Google login if Google Drive is not properly configured.
Enhanced OAuth authentication flow by routing callbacks directly through the website, resulting in a more reliable login experience for cloud providers.
Updated the extension's logo across the interface.
Revamped the Reading Log history to visually differentiate reading actions with colored badges (Read, Chapter Read, Re-read) and now tracks the exact chapter numbers you read.
Added an undo button after marking a work as read.
Expanded the Top Fandoms and Authors panels to display more detailed insights.
Added 'Want to Read' (WTR) badges to work listings, matching the style of other tags.
Fixed a bug where the word count sometimes incorrectly recorded only ~28 words instead of the actual chapter count.
Fixed a bug where 'Do Not Read' or 'Marked Read' statuses disappeared when navigating between pages.
Fixed a bug where Bookmark Sync fired requests without rate limiting to AO3, improving sync stability.
Kudos Tracking module: automatically map and display all your given kudos.
Fixed an issue where the auto-folding feature could not be disabled after being activated.
Added storage usage indicator in Options.
Added 'Read' and 'Chapter Read' buttons to the end of the chapter page.
Added checkpoints to the goal progress bar.
Dynamic year label in Stats Config.
Fixed the text color of the button on the work page.

Improved the UX/UI of the PRO showcase panel: moved the 'Hide Showcase Icon Permanently' button to the header as a highlighted pill button, and made the 'x' close button also hide the icon permanently.
Fixed an incorrect word count being recorded on Firefox for Android — numbers formatted with locale-specific thousand separators (spaces or non-breaking spaces) are now correctly parsed.
Separated 'Want to Read' bookmarks from the standard bookmark listing — WTR items are now hidden by default and accessible via a dedicated 'Want to Read' button.
Added a persistent floating Chapter Review button that follows the scroll on work pages, with auto-save when clicking outside the modal and a toggle in the Options dashboard to enable/disable it.
Added option to customize where infinite scroll is active (tags, bookmarks, etc).
Enabled colors and filters on the 'Mark for Later' listing page.
Added a hex color input field for custom colors in options.
Fixed infinite scroll on the history table in the stats dashboard.
Fixed an issue where Notebook items showed as 'work', unknown tag/author after restoring a Drive backup.
Fixed the chapter link in the Notebook not redirecting correctly.
Removed manual upload button from AO3 when automatic backup is enabled.
Added a scrollbar to the Notebook dashboard to prevent infinite page expansion.
Fixed a bug where the extension would stop working after submitting a review.
Created the Notebook dashboard to view all chapter reviews centrally.
Optimized demonstration GIFs to significantly reduce extension size.
Redesigned the chapter review modal for a cleaner, modern look.
Added Google Drive Cloud Backup & Sync support.
Implemented automatic backup syncing for JSONBin.io.
Added manual backup download functionality.
Implemented secure OAuth2 authentication for cloud providers.
Fixed a bug where the 'Want to Read' button became incorrectly re-enabled when navigating to the next chapter.
Added 'Want to Read' functionality to save fics for later.
Moved Chapter Review Bin ID to Cloud Settings and disabled manual upload/download buttons.
Added a scrollbar to the Highlights menu to prevent infinite page expansion.
Added 'Hide Read Works' filter to infinite scroll search pages.
Automatically redirect to Release Notes when the extension is updated.
